config.kuvalich.moduleAttributeMultiplie:
Global multiplier applied to all module attribute values (including Riven modules)
§71.0§r = original values (default)
§72.0§r = double all stats
§70.5§r = halve all stats
Applies to all tiers of weapon and warframe modules:
Common / Uncommon / Rare / Prime / Riven
§cRiven modules: multiplier is applied on top of random roll and trend scaling§r
Negative stats (e.g. -firing rate) are also scaled proportionally

§eWhat changed:§r Previously this multiplier only affected fixed modules (Common/Uncommon/Rare/Prime). Riven modules were excluded.
Now Riven modules are also affected.

§eExample (Weapon Riven, Trend 3):§r
Base melee damage value: 1.65
After trend scaling (×1.0) + random roll (×0.95): 1.5675
With multiplier §72.0§r → §a3.135§r
With multiplier §70.5§r → §a0.784§r

§eExample (negative stat):§r
Base firing rate penalty: 0.6
After trend/random: −0.495
With multiplier §72.0§r → §c−0.99§r
config.kuvalich.keyAttributeMultiplier.t:

Includes: all crit chance/multiplier, trigger chance/time, shield recovery rate/delay, and their kill-stack versions
Independent from general attribute multiplier, both default to 1.0
1.0 = original values (default)

config.kuvalich.maxConfiscatedItems.tool:
Maximum items a Kuva Lich can confiscate per riddle cycle
§764§r = Max 64 (default)
§70§r = Disable confiscation regardless of chance
config.kuvalich.formaLockEnabled.tooltip:
When enabled, each Forma re-roll has a chance to
permanently lock the weapon's base panel attributes
Locked weapons cannot be re-rolled with Forma again
§7false§r = Disabled (default)
config.kuvalich.formaLockChance.tooltip:
Chance to permanently lock panel after Forma re-roll
§710.0§r = 10%% chance (default)
Only effective when Forma Lock is enabled
Locked panels are permanently fixed and cannot be reset
